_demo_meta.scenario: json_extract_string executes via MCP query tool (UDF registered, no 'unknown function' error)

mcp_wire_demo.description: SQL-pipe mode query: json_extract_string in SELECT head with pipe | limit stage. Demonstrates UDF is registered in DataFusion SessionContext — query passes plan gate and proceeds to sensor fan-out. E-SENSOR-010 is returned because no live Claroty instance (dummy credentials), confirming the failure point is the sensor, NOT the UDF registration.

arguments.query: SELECT json_extract_string(raw_extensions, 'severity') AS jex_severity FROM claroty_alerts | limit 5

assertions.note: E-SENSOR-010 is a credential/connection error — the UDF was registered and DataFusion accepted the query. Without a live sensor, 0 rows are returned. This confirms json_extract_string is registered in the DataFusion SessionContext per ADR-066 §E.

unit_test_evidence.description: RG-JEX-011 unit test uses JexMockAdapter with synthetic data to assert actual extraction values at the DataFusion / Arrow level. Wire-shape assertion per SID-2 (CLAUDE.md): the test asserts on Arrow StringArray values after full engine execution.
key_assertions: extracted_col.is_null(1) == true (row 1: {"severity":null,...} → SQL NULL (JSON null at key))
unit_test_evidence.sap3_compliance: Test exercises full prism_query public API: QueryEngine::execute() → pipe_sql_emitter → DataFusion → json_extract_string UDF → result batches
